name: data-dot-merge
title: Data Cluster Merge
description: Chín chấm nhóm A và bảy chấm nhóm B bay theo đường cong vào giữa, xếp thành hình hoa hướng dương mà vẫn giữ màu nhóm.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-data-story-cluster-merge, written here): Group A: 9 dots (r 5) in a 3 x 3 grid, 16 px pitch, left; group B: 7 dots in a hex cluster, right. Each dot flies to a sunflower spot around the centre (radius 8 sqrt(j + 0.5) px, angle j x 137.5 deg), 750 ms easeInOut, from 900 ms + 45 ms per dot, path bowed +-14 px (A up, B down). 'A 9' / 'B 7' fade out 700-1000; '9 + 7 = 16' + ring fade in 2000-2300. Dots keep group colours. Params: dots (9 + 7) · stagger (45 ms) · duration bay (0.75 s).
